correctness.rationale: Complete direct and forbidden-triple enumerations of 8192 subsets agree. Matching has 149 pairs, 14 critical cells, and its 312-vertex 897-incidence orientation is acyclic. Exact integral Morse matrix has rank five and a unit five-by-five minor; attaching maps from seven three-cells to six two-spheres are thus reduced to five degree-one attachments and two nullhomotopic attachments. The full 78-element affine automorphism action is checked and reduced Lefschetz data force the sign/Eisenstein integral representations; quotient rational homology follows by finite-group invariants. The remaining topological arguments are justified by standard theorems.

value.rationale: The toroidal, strongly regular order-thirteen Paley graph has a distinguished intrinsic first higher-independence complex. The pure complex has homology in two distinct dimensions and is non-shellable, a useful structural contrast with equidimensional families. Its full integral affine homology modules separate sign and Eisenstein actions and yield rational acyclicity of its symmetry quotient. The exact natural invariant is not a merely arbitrary finite restriction.
